    Double-clicktap Enzo, Bob, Mira or Doug to train or trade (or target them and press U). Drag something from your bag onto someone to give it to them. Foes wind up before they strike — that is your moment to dodge. Type /wave, /cheer, /bow, /dance, /sit or /howl in chat, or /play to take out a tin whistle and play along (keys 1–8). Every people remembers what you kill: C on their folk shows how they regard you, and the character window lists them all.
